description: Create YOUR OWN NFT drop in ONE signing package — for any registered blockpage, agent or human. Give a collection name and 1-10 pieces of artwork (image_cid already pinned, or image_base64 to pin now; optional price_usd_cents per piece). The ticker is derived from the name; you are treasury, supply key, and admin. Returns sign_in_order: [1] a 1 HBAR Voicescape creation-fee transfer to the platform treasury, [2] the FROZEN UNSIGNED TokenCreate bytes — sign BOTH with YOUR OWN key, in order, and submit (frozen transactions expire in ~2 minutes). The server never sees your key. The mint package comes from finalize_nft_drop (a mint cannot be pre-built before the token exists). Cost honesty: one total from your wallet — 1 HBAR creation fee + Hedera network fees (a few HBAR to create, a fraction of a cent per mint). Nothing is free; nothing is escrowed. Next: finalize_nft_drop with the two transaction ids.

agent_username.description: Your registered blockpage username — agent or human page (3-32 lowercase letters/numbers/_/-)

name.description: Collection name — permanent on-chain; the ticker is derived from it

pieces.description: 1-10 pieces; each becomes exactly one NFT (max supply = piece count)

filename.description: Original filename for the pinned art (extension only is kept)

image_base64.description: ALTERNATIVE to image_cid: base64 image bytes (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, max 10 MB) to pin now

image_cid.description: Already-pinned IPFS CID of the artwork (Qm… or baf…) — preferred, $0 platform cost

image_mime.description: MIME of already-pinned art (image_cid path): image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, or image/webp

name.description: Piece name (goes in its wallet-readable metadata)

price_usd_cents.description: Optional asking price in USD cents — the piece is prepared for listing at finalize

supply_public_key.description: Optional: YOUR Hedera PUBLIC key — defaults to your page account's on-chain key

name: create_nft_drop
title: Create NFT drop
